g.title: Long shot. In the rain. Alice, left, pointing, sweating, looking at Bob; Bob, centre, arms crossed. Caption: Eight o'clock. Still raining. Sound effect: VROOM. Alice: That was our bus! Bob: Then we take the train.
Medium close-up. Alice, centre, scared. Alice, thinking: We'll never make it.
Ana, left; Ben, centre. Caption: Platform 4. Ten past nine. Ana: Is it always this late? Ben: Only when it rains somewhere else.
